source.paraphrase: A domain boundary must validate the complete admitted value and its bounds. TypeCompatibilityCheck and DCast must not be treated as strict type, complete collection or domain validation.

invariants.why: A domain boundary must validate the complete admitted value and its bounds. TypeCompatibilityCheck and DCast must not be treated as strict type, complete collection or domain validation. The product uses compatibility or conversion helpers to admit external or stored values.
invariants.fixHint: Test actual strict types, every collection item, numeric precision and domain constraints. Own input depth and size budgets; recursive compatibility on a cyclic object can overflow the stack. Compatibility admits numeric strings, inspects only the first array element, and can match an object's keys without validating field values. Boolean conversion of the strings false and no returns true. Reject unsafe values before the domain decision. Bind DCP-UTILITY-RUNTIME-001 to a human-reviewed project assertion with explicit applicability, owner, actual application inputs and freshness. Include a failing control. Run pregate fitness run DCP-UTILITY-RUNTIME-001.
invariants.avoid: Project evidence gate, not a syntax detector or complete library certification. Source canaries verify the upstream contrast, not consumer compliance. Receipt fixtures verify evidence admission only. No executable command is supplied by this pack. Missing bindings remain UNVERIFIED; an adopted enforcing binding blocks stale or failed evidence, while shadow stays diagnostic. Conditional non-use requires an explicit reviewed reason and evidence, not an unexplained success.

source.paraphrase: A conversion boundary must have an explicit policy for absent values, fallback values and exceptions. A fallback must satisfy the consumer's domain contract. A fallback must not be assumed to handle every conversion failure.

invariants.why: A conversion boundary must have an explicit policy for absent values, fallback values and exceptions. A fallback must satisfy the consumer's domain contract. A fallback must not be assumed to handle every conversion failure. DCast can receive nullish or invalid data or a caller supplies a fallback.
invariants.fixHint: Test null, undefined, unsupported conversion, absent and explicit fallback, malformed target configuration and native conversion exceptions. The pinned runtime returns nullish input even for a different requested target, returns a supplied fallback without converting or copying it, and validates target shape before fallback. source.paraphrase: An array passed to DCast must be an intentional value-and-format tuple. A caller must not use this argument as a whole-collection conversion. Tuple contents and metadata must be validated before use.

invariants.why: An array passed to DCast must be an intentional value-and-format tuple. A caller must not use this argument as a whole-collection conversion. Tuple contents and metadata must be validated before use. The product passes array or tuple input to DCast.

The product submits work through an IPriorityQueue adapter or translates external priority data into queue calls.
